05 // EXECUTION METHODOLOGY

FROM BRIEF TO DELIVERY.

STRUCTURAL & ARCHITECTURAL WORKFLOW PIPELINE FROM INITIAL DRAWINGS TO FINAL REVI ASSETS.

01

RECEIVE DRAWINGS / PROJECT BRIEF

Client submits 2D CAD files (.DWG), hand sketches, structural layouts, or PDF documentation along with project requirements.

INPUT: .DWG / PDF / SKETCH
02

REVIEW SCOPE & LOD

Our technical team reviews project complexity, specifies the Level of Development (LOD 200–400), and defines modeling standards.

SPEC: LOD 200 / 300 / 350 / 400
03

CONFIRM QUOTATION & TIMELINE

Clear project quotation, milestone schedule, and delivery deadlines are established with transparent milestone billing.

SCHEDULE & COMMERCIAL AGREEMENT
04

REVIT MODELING

Parametric 3D BIM model construction commences in Autodesk Revit, building architectural and structural elements to scale.

AUTODESK REVIT PARMETRIC BUILD
05

INTERNAL DRAWING / MODEL CHECK

Quality assurance inspection conducted internally to audit dimensional consistency, family parameters, and drawing standards.

QA / QC INTERNAL AUDIT
06

CLIENT REVIEW

First model draft or interim sheet set delivered to client for design review, markup feedback, and consultant comments.

CLIENT & CONSULTANT MARKUP
07

REVISIONS

Prompt incorporation of client feedback, design revisions, structural modifications, or architectural updates.

REVISION INCORPORATION & TRACKING
08

FINAL MODEL & DRAWINGS

Delivery of clean native Revit (.RVT) models, exported DWG drawing packages, high-resolution PDF sets, and BIM schedules.

DELIVERY: .RVT + .DWG + .PDF + SCHED
